verdict.rationale: Plausible offers a single fixed per-site dashboard (plus a consolidated multi-site view and shared/embedded links), filters, comparisons and annotations, but there is no evidence of a feature to save individual insights/reports and compose them into custom, shareable dashboards as a PM workflow. missing for 10: saved-insight objects, a dashboard-builder/composition UI, and evidence of arranging multiple saved insights into a single custom shareable dashboard.
